name: Real estate agent to sell my house?

mainEntity.name: Real estate agent to sell my house?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a real estate agent to sell your house, look for local market knowledge, a credible valuation process, a written marketing plan, communication standards, negotiation experience, and a clear approach to buyer screening and closing coordination. Kelby Contreras provides seller representation across Miami and South Florida.
